statement: Build a singly linked list from the given values, then search it for a target value. Print the number of hops from the head to the first node holding the target, counting the head as 0. If no node holds the target, print -1. The search must walk the pointers; the position must reflect the chain, so stop at the first hit.

example.why: The first 9 sits one hop from the head; the later 9 is no longer the answer.

hint: Carry the hop count in the same loop that walks; leave the loop the moment the value matches.
mistake: Walking the whole chain and reporting the last match - the task asks for the first.
